column1: # Every file in app/ that differs from the upstream pin, and why.
# Enforced by scripts/check-upstream-delta.py. An undeclared difference fails; a declared entry
# that is no longer different also fails, so this file cannot quietly stop describing the tree.
# layer — which kind of change this is. The categories exist because the project's three restarts
#         all came from rewriting where re-skinning would have done:
#   L0  a fix to an upstream defect. Ideally also reported upstream.
#   L1  re-skin only: text, typography, icon, size, radius, shadow, gradient, motion, token,
#       className. Structure, props, exports and behaviour stay upstream's. If a diff in an L1 file
#       touches anything else, it is mislabelled.
#   L2  a deliberate product change, which must already be classified REUSE/EXTEND/NEW and must
#       name where any removed function now lives. A page or control that disappears with no
#       named destination is the failure mode this column exists to prevent.
#       For a lost production component reference, use an L2 reason with replacement: <new home
#       or explicit retirement decision>. If the component itself is unchanged, declare the
#       changed caller and add removes: <exact component path>; replacement: <destination>.
#       The check is a reference heuristic, not proof that a component renders or is reachable.
#   LOC local-only state that is not product code (baselines, caches).
# MISSING: prefix means upstream ships the file and we do not. It needs a louder reason than an
# ordinary edit, because that is the shape that loses features silently.
